contentPattern.structure: logo image + title + description + Visit Site button

suitableFor: brand / partner tile grids with a logo, category title, description and a Visit Site CTA
2-up or 3-up promo tiles on a light section where each tile has its own external link button
notSuitableFor: icon-only category navigation tiles with no button (use cards-catalog)
editorial article grids on a dark section (use cards-article)
blue product-category tiles with a See Products CTA (use cards-category)
